dialogues.speaker: Phonia
dialogues.text: I've been recovering well, and have returned to work at full strength.

dialogues.speaker: Phonia
dialogues.text: I've got the Acting Grand Master and Captain Albedo to thank for that. Only Ematol and the knights who escorted me back then know exactly what happened to me.

dialogues.speaker: Phonia
dialogues.text: Most of my fellow knights don't think less of me, and I'm able to get my work done without trouble.

dialogues.speaker: Phonia
dialogues.text: I've also finished the outline for my book, "The Knight's Guide to the Prevention and Management of Psychic Disruption," which uses my misstep as a case study. I'll do my best to complete the full manuscript as soon as possible.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And what's going on in the rest of your life?

dialogues.speaker: Phonia
dialogues.text: After my transfer here to Dornman Port, I rented out my house and moved into a new place here with Ematol.

dialogues.speaker: Phonia
dialogues.text: We have plenty of space in the living room for cat trees and cat toys, as well as for Dustball, the cat Ematol adopted.

dialogues.speaker: Phonia
dialogues.text: Thanks to the two of them, I've been in a rather good mood lately...

dialogues.speaker: Phonia
dialogues.text: Leonore also comes by to see us every now and then. It does feel like my life is becoming more interesting.

dialogues.speaker: Phonia
dialogues.text: Say, if you're ever around and have the time, do drop by for some tea too. I'd love to pick your brain about possible future directions for the Knights of Favonius.
